hook.text: Airlines charge $200 for a seat one person pays $800 for. Same seat, same flight. Different prices.

buildup.text: Price discrimination means charging different customers different prices based on willingness to pay.

discovery.text: Strategies include: student discounts, early-bird pricing, premium tiers, and geographic pricing.

twist.text: It only works if customers can't resell. You can't buy a cheap student flight and sell it to a business traveler.

climax.text: Perfect price discrimination captures all consumer surplus. In practice, firms approximate it with segmentation.

punchline.text: Same product, different price, more profit.

quiz.question: What prevents price discrimination from working?
options: If customers can resell to each other
